recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current HL7/fhir source follow-up is needed unless a future R4B publication rebuild shows a tooling regression.
issue_request: FHIR-35783 was a Published/Persuasive R4B technical correction saying conceptmaps.xml used target.relationship and R5 relationship codes where R4B required target.equivalence and R4/R4B equivalence codes.
initial_application: The Jira resolution says to fix the generation code, and the Jira comment links HL7/kindling#69, merged 2022-04-07, which cites FHIR-35783 as part of the version-correct R4B generated-resource fix.
additional_context: FHIR-35783 is tightly connected to seed FHIR-34433. Current ConceptMap source correctly uses relationship, while origin/R4B uses equivalence. FHIR-35784 is the companion valuesets.xml issue and already has an audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source is correct and the requested R4B conceptmaps.xml correction belongs to the already-applied Kindling/R4B generation path.
